title: Non-destructive stripping electrochemistry enables long-life zinc metal batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,2353-2364
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05044D, Paper
Ruiting Guo, Xiong Liu, Kun Ni, Fanjie Xia, Huazhang Zhang, Yu Liu, Xinzhe Dai, Litong Shi, Xuanpeng Wang, Chunhua Han, Liqiang Mai, Chaojiang Niu
A non-destructive stripping strategy has been proposed for the first time to solve the anomalous detachment issue of an interface layer and preserve its structural and functional integrity for long-life Zn metal batteries.
